messages:
alex: Heads-up — bringing up quantized-7b-v2 on the eval harness; judges disagree wildly on some prompts, A/B run shows ~18% pairwise disagreement. Rerunning but wanted to sync on tie-break policy and calibration.
priya: On it. Do you have the failing prompt ids? can we reproduce locally? :eyes: 
alex: Runner command I used: ```./eval_runner --model quant-7b-v2 --panel judge-ensemble --seed 42 --batch 128``` Repro ids: 7891, 7902, 7930. CI job attached.
ci-bot: CI RERUN complete: job 4923. Panels: judge-alpha, judge-beta, judge-gamma. Disagreement summary: 18.2% pairwise flip, median confidence delta 0.12. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/4923/report.html
jordan: judge-beta flips more on the social-bias subset — smells like priming. It uses a slightly different few-shot template.
priya: Can we try anchor priming vs null context and force deterministic sampling? quantized models often show lower entropy hence higher flip rates.
alex: Config excerpt: ```temp: 0.0
top_p: 0.95
max_tokens: 512
judge_prompt_template: default``` We didn't change sampling params. Could be a runtime logits-scaling bug in the quantized path.
emma: Reminder: current tie-break policy = majority wins; if 2-2 tie we consult meta-judge (judge-gamma) else fallback to golden-label. For new model bring-up we should force meta-judge deterministic seed. Proposal: confidence-weighted tie-breaker with threshold 0.15.
priya: Confidence-weighted tie-breaker makes sense, but judges need calibration first — quantization can shift calibration. We should compute per-judge ECE pre/post quant and reweight accordingly.
alex: Plan: (1) rerun with deterministic meta-judge seed + anchor examples, (2) compute ECE and derive reweight factors, (3) if disagreement > 10% after reweighting, trigger adjudication human review. Who owns 1-2?
jordan: I'll own step 1 (reruns) and wire deterministic seed into the harness; will attach run IDs.
emma: I'll run ECE calc and propose reweight factors and confidence threshold; also check per-slice calibration (bias-related slices). Do we persist per-judge logits?
ci-bot: Artifact upload: logs + logits available at s3://redwood-evals/4923/logits.tar.gz (expires in 30d).
priya: Tagging product/quality and scheduling a quick sync with them if we see systemic bias shift. @emma @jordan aim for EOD updates.
alex: Thanks — if we find systemic bias or calibration drift, pause rollout and escalate. :thumbsup:
